title: Model Quantization Techniques
summary: This module provides a collection of quantization methods for optimizing model size and inference speed. It includes implementations for various bit-widths and techniques like BitNet, bitsandbytes (4-bit and 8-bit), FP8, FP-Quant, Metal, MXFP4, Quark, SINQ, and TorchAo, supporting both pre-quantized model loading and on-the-fly quantization.

nodes.label: Pre-trained Model
nodes.title: Pre-trained Model
nodes.description: Represents a pre-trained model loaded into the system, which can be subjected to various quantization techniques.

nodes.label: BitNet Quantizer
nodes.title: BitNet 1.58-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Applies 1.58-bit quantization using the BitNet method, converting linear layers to BitLinear for efficient inference. Requires 'accelerate'.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Implements 4-bit quantization for model weights using the bitsandbytes library, reducing memory footprint. Requires 'accelerate' and 'bitsandbytes'.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantizer
nodes.title: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantization
nodes.description: Implements 8-bit quantization for model weights using the bitsandbytes library, balancing precision and memory. Requires 'accelerate' and 'bitsandbytes'.

nodes.label: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantizer
nodes.title: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantization
nodes.description: Provides FP8 quantization, supporting standard and MoE models, leveraging GPU/XPU capabilities for performance. Requires 'accelerate' and compatible GPU/XPU.

nodes.label: FP-Quant Quantizer
nodes.title: FP-Quant Method
nodes.description: Handles FP-Quant method for loading pre-quantized models or on-the-fly quantization, optimized for specific hardware. Requires GPU/XPU, 'qutlass' (for real quant), and 'fp_quant'.

nodes.label: Metal Quantizer
nodes.title: Metal Affine Quantization (MPS)
nodes.description: Enables Metal affine quantization for Apple Silicon (MPS) devices, utilizing low-bit uint32 tensors with fused dequantization. Requires MPS device and 'kernels'.

nodes.label: MXFP4 Quantizer
nodes.title: MXFP4 Quantization
nodes.description: Performs FP4 quantization using FBGEMM kernels, suitable for various hardware with specific compute capabilities. Requires 'torch', 'accelerate', 'triton', 'kernels', and compatible GPU/XPU.

nodes.label: Quark Quantizer
nodes.title: Quark Quantization
nodes.description: Integrates Quark quantization for efficient model deployment, primarily for pre-quantized models. Requires the 'quark' library.

nodes.label: SINQ Quantizer
nodes.title: SINQ Quantization
nodes.description: Applies SINQ quantization, supporting weight-only or activation-aware methods, converting linear layers to SINQLinear. Requires 'sinq' and CUDA.

nodes.label: TorchAo Quantizer
nodes.title: TorchAo Quantization
nodes.description: Utilizes the torchao library for various quantization types, including 4-bit and 8-bit, with support for training. Requires 'torchao'.

groups.label: Quantization Methods
groups.title: Quantization Implementations
groups.description: Provides various quantization algorithms and their specific configurations.

groups.label: Model Interface
groups.title: Model to Quantize
groups.description: The target model that undergoes quantization.
